instrument: Military Installation Development Authority project area approval (Hansel Valley)
summary: MIDA, a quasi-governmental authority, approved a project area of approximately 41,200 acres in Hansel Valley, Box Elder County, providing the zoning pathway for the Stratos data center campus. MIDA was chaired at the time by the Utah Senate President.
notes: Approval reported in late April 2026. The MIDA route is an approval pathway not used by any other entry in the register; county zoning was not the controlling instrument.
confidence_note: Relayed from reporting; the MIDA board action has not been read in original.

source.citation: Utah news coverage, June 2026; Salt Lake Tribune, Deseret News and KSL reporting on the Stratos project
